title: Zumba Wajib
subject: HR's compulsory Friday-evening Zumba session in the office meeting room, and the stiff finance manager who turns out to be the best dancer on the floor
caption: Electro-disco live party band in the current Malaysian live-band style. Live four-on-the-floor drums with open hi-hats on the off-beat; an octave-jumping slap bass doubled by a fat analog synth bass; a tenor saxophone blowing short riffs between lines; a choppy funk rhythm guitar on the upbeats; string-machine stabs on the chorus. Glossy and loud, kick and bass wide, saxophone and lead voice forward, a short plate reverb. Male voice, bright playful tenor, talk-singing the verses and belting the chorus; the band shouting the dance counts in unison. 122 BPM, F minor. Giddy, sweaty and triumphant. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no rock guitar solo.
lyrics:
[Intro - drums and slap bass, saxophone riff]

[Verse 1]
Jumaat pukul lima, e-mel dari HR
Semua staf wajib turun bilik mesyuarat
Meja ditolak tepi, kerusi disusun
Cikgu Zumba datang dengan speaker besar

[Pre-Chorus]
Encik Rahman finance, tali leher kemas
Berdiri belakang sekali, muka masam

[Chorus]
Zumba wajib, kiri kanan pusing
Peluh dah basah baju kerja
Zumba wajib, satu dua tiga
Siapa sangka bos kita boleh goyang

[Verse 2]
Lagu kedua, Encik Rahman buka kot
Lagu ketiga, dia ke depan sekali
Pinggul dia laju, tangan dia lawa
Cikgu Zumba pun berhenti tengok

[Pre-Chorus]
Rupanya dulu dia juara tari
Masa belajar kat Shah Alam

[Chorus]
Zumba wajib, ikut Encik Rahman
Budak IT pun tak nak balik
Zumba wajib, satu dua tiga
Minggu depan kita minta dua kali

[Outro - saxophone and drums]
Claim kewangan lambat pun tak apa
